scene_description: Two young boys are sliding together down a black-and-white striped water slide into a bright blue swimming pool. Water is splashing around them. Both boys are smiling and have their arms raised with thumbs up. The boy in front is wearing red-striped swim trunks and goggles.

questions.question: What are the boys going down?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big black-and-white thing the boys are sitting on.

questions.question: What are the two boys doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the boys are doing with their bodies on the slide.

questions.question: Where are the boys sliding into?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the blue water at the bottom of the slide.

questions.question: What is the boy in front wearing on his face?
questions.sentence_frame: He is wearing ___ on his face.
questions.evidence_hint: Look closely at the face of the boy sitting in front.

questions.question: How do the boys look — are they happy or scared?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the boys' faces and their arms in the air.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on a water slide? What was it like?
optional_extension_questions.sentence_frame: I went on a slide and it was ___.
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you went swimming or to a water park.
